speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes; these are concerning for a systemic process like lymphoma or tuberculosis. To narrow this down, have you noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits, such as diarrhea or constipation, alongside the abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; the combination of weight loss and night sweats is significant. Has the abdominal pain radiated to your back, and have you experienced any fever or changes in your urine color?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential and LDH levels.  
REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray and Abdominal_Ultrasound.
